name: Fiery Confluence

abilities.text: Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once.

notes: "You may choose the same mode more than once" is the family `choose-modes` with `repeat` — the core `choose-mode` cannot say it, and repeating a mode is the whole card. The third mode's "target artifact" is therefore a `choose-objects` pick plus `chosen-fate destroy`: an effect inside a family mode is never offered a target at cast time (docs/vocabulary/piles-choices.md 5), so the artifact is chosen as the spell resolves.

issues: • Destroy target artifact. — expected a target artifact chosen on cast, checked for shroud/protection and for legality (the mode cannot be chosen with no legal target) — scripted choose-objects {types:[Artifact], who:each-player} + chosen-fate {chosen:{how:'destroy'}} — no target; chosen at resolution, and the mode can be picked with no artifact in play and simply do nothing — CR 115.1, 700.2c

Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once. — expected three modes (repeats allowed) declared as the spell is cast, before anyone responds — scripted family choose-modes count:3 repeat:true chooses on resolution. `repeat` is only in the family op and targets are only in the core `choose-mode` (piles-choices.md §5), so no currently expressible script covers both clauses — an open vocabulary need, not an author slip. Modes 1 and 2 (1 damage to each creature / 2 damage to each opponent) are exact — CR 700.2d, 601.2b
